dct_description_sm:
Credit Valley Conservation (CVC) operates a network of 59 environmental monitoring stations strategically located throughout the Credit River Watershed. Of these, 11 stations are dedicated to real-time water quality monitoring. These stations provide continuous information on environmental conditions to support flood forecasting, water quality assessment, and low water level warnings. Data are retrieved through the Water Information System by KISTERS (WISKI) platform and include the following parameters: 
•	Air Temperature
•	Chloride 
•	Dissolved Oxygen
•	pH
•	Specific Conductivity
•	Turbidity
•	Water Temperature
dct_title_s: Credit Valley Conservation Water Quality data
